div.span:
CONSTRAINT chk_appointments_slot CHECK (
SECOND(appointment_datetime) = 0
AND MINUTE(appointment_datetime) IN (0, 30)
AND TIME(appointment_datetime)
BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '16:30:00').
Appointments retain cancellation and refund history.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1318px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1475px; margin-left: 2px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: • A doctor can have only one active booking per exact date/time: UNIQUE(doctor_id, appointment_datetime, active_slot_key).
• Cancelled rows produce NULL active_slot_key; MySQL permits multiple NULLs in a UNIQUE index, so history remains and the slot reopens.
• CHECK (consultation_fee >= 0); CHECK (amount_paid >= 0); CHECK (refund_amount IS NULL OR refund_amount >= 0).
• CHECK (refund_percentage IS NULL OR refund_percentage IN (0,50,100)); appointment slot CHECK: SECOND=0, MINUTE IN (0,30), HOUR 9:00-16:30.
• Patient email and phone are UNIQUE; required fields are NOT NULL. Future-only and max 12 appointments/doctor/day require transactional enforcement.
